A '''terrorist group''' existed<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|298|Vaykaaris Uprising}}</ref> in approximately [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]]. Around that date,<ref name="Date">{{CSWECite|III|298|Vaykaaris Uprising}} dates the [[Vaykaaris Uprising]] to approximately 45 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the latter conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Vaykaaris Uprising can therefore be placed in around [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]].</ref> the group was based in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Vaykaaris system/Legends|Vaykaaris system]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and threatened more than a hundred [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the Colonies.<ref name="CSWE" />
